chapters.title: Original Intro
chapters.description: The production 19-frame intro, including its original fade into frame 19.

chapters.title: Load LFM
chapters.description: Two-second illustrative loading progress for the release-default LFM model; not a benchmark.

chapters.title: Type and Send
chapters.description: Type 'what can you do?' on the production on-screen keyboard and explicitly select SEND.

chapters.title: Sample Reply
chapters.description: Predefined sample text streams through the production reply renderer; no model runs.

chapters.title: Read Aloud
chapters.description: Select the speaker glyph and follow word highlighting; offline speech when available, otherwise silent.

chapters.title: USB Microphone Test
chapters.description: R2 opens settings; navigate to VOICE, select USB, then simulate four seconds each of recording and playback, followed by a verdict. No microphone access.

chapters.title: Dictate and Review
chapters.description: Select MIC, simulate recording and transcription, review the draft, then explicitly SEND a second sample question.

chapters.title: Reopen History
chapters.description: Open in-memory sample history, navigate between entries, and reopen the walkthrough conversation.

chapters.title: Close the App
chapters.description: Pause on the reopened chat, then show STOP and fade out as the scripted app closes.

micPlayback.text: This is a microphone test. Your voice stays on the device.
